push_inventory.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 identity, NUL, u16-le wire-id, u8 kind=1

encoder_rgb_inventory.identity_policy: Reuse parameter.1 through parameter.8 only within LED_RENDER destination namespace
encoder_rgb_inventory.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 identity, NUL, u16-le existing rotation wire-id, u8 kind=2

inventory_response_extension.message: INVENTORY (existing type 13; extended payload only after proposed minor negotiation)
